_comment_attrForm: `innerhtml` carries `fieldName: "innerHTML"`, so the property form writes the key
`_VirtualDom_noInnerHtmlOrFormAction` rewrites. Selecting the property form here is what
makes the kernel-blocked guard's form-dependence testable: the same attribute left as a
content attribute is NOT blocked (HTML has no `innerhtml` attribute for the kernel to
rewrite), so only this config line puts it in the guard's path.
